_comment: The feed's THIRD shape, and the one that cost us: a date that has passed but whose roster
the feed has not flipped yet. Against nasdaq-earnings-sample.json nothing is missing — the
session and the lastYearRptDt/lastYearEPS pair are still there — but an 'eps' column has
appeared, holding LAST YEAR's figure rather than what was just reported.
Reconstructed from what this app cached for 2026-10-29 when it asked at 06:03 New York the
following morning: 270 of 303 rows were stored with the year-ago quarter as the actual, and
SNDK's $0.90 against a $46.19 consensus was published as a 98% miss. By the time the feed had
flipped, SNDK's real figure was $48.92 — a 5.9% beat. MRDN is the variant with no year-ago
quarter: a blank lastYearEPS beside an 'eps' of $0, which read as an actual is a manufactured
zero. Public market facts about public companies — no account data, as src/test/resources
